name: How to Compress a PDF
description: Reduce PDF file size without losing quality — free, processed in your browser.

step.name: Open your PDF
step.text: Click 'Choose files' or drag your PDF into the drop zone.

step.name: Choose compression level
step.text: Select Low (minimal quality loss), Medium (balanced), or High (maximum reduction) compression.

step.name: Download the compressed PDF
step.text: Click 'Compress PDF'. Your reduced file downloads automatically. The tool shows you how much size was saved.
